summary: Per-frame dispatch by object type: reads the type selector dword at this+4 and routes through the jump table (jpt_4CDB2F at 0x004CDB58 with data at byte_4CDB74 at 0x004CDB74) to a type-specific update handler, forwarding a1 and the @st0 double a2. Types 0-4 route to ParticleInstanceUpdate, 5 to WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate, 6-7 to ScoringGateTimeoutCheck, 8 to TelemetryBarIndicatorRenderer, 12 to ParticleSystemUpdateWithWindAndDamping, 13 to ParticleEffectPhysics. Any other type returns the selector unchanged without updating. Called by WeatherParticleUpdate (004CFCC0).

operations.description: Read the object type selector dword at this+4; it selects the update path.
Switch dispatch through the jump table at global jpt_4CDB2F (0x004CDB58) with its table data at byte_4CDB74 (0x004CDB74).
Types 0-4: ParticleInstanceUpdate(a1, a2) updates a particle instance.
Type 5: WheelRenderObjectPerFrameUpdate(a1, a2) updates a wheel render object.
Types 6-7: ScoringGateTimeoutCheck(a1, a2) checks a scoring gate timeout.
Type 8: TelemetryBarIndicatorRenderer(a1, a2) renders a telemetry bar indicator.
Type 12: ParticleSystemUpdateWithWindAndDamping(a1, a2) updates a particle system with wind and damping.
Type 13: ParticleEffectPhysics(a1, a2) runs particle effect physics.
Default case returns the type selector unchanged without any update; the dispatched results are returned from the dispatch path, and the function is invoked by WeatherParticleUpdate (004CFCC0).

unresolved: The six dispatch target functions carry decompiler names only; the packet lists no callee entries for them, so their addresses and identities are unverified evidence.
The purpose of the @st0 double argument a2 and of the selector return value for the default path is unknown.
Type values 9-11 and 14+ have no defined handler in this function.
